scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/sidecar" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:sidecar: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w apps/sidecar
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w apps/sidecar && npm run build -w apps/web
